name: Weather Plugin
author: PrismAI
description: An example plugin that fetches real weather data from the Open-Meteo API. Demonstrates async HTTP calls, health checks, and secrets declaration in the PrismAI plugin system.

get_forecast.description: Get the current weather forecast for a location. Returns temperature, wind speed, and weather description.

location.description: City name (e.g., 'London', 'New York', 'Tokyo'). The location is geocoded automatically.

secrets.description: API key for weather provider (not required for Open-Meteo free tier, declared for demonstration of the secrets pattern).
